key_concepts: Sex-linked traits are carried on sex chromosomes and include color blindness and hemophili
Punnett squares can predict probabilities of sex-linked trait inheritance.
Color blindness is a sex-linked recessive trait.
Hemophilia is a sex-linked recessive trait.
Sex-limited traits are expressed in only one sex, such as milk production in cows and bear
Sex-influenced traits are influenced by sex hormones, such as baldness in men.
DNA is made of repeating units called nucleotides.
A nucleotide consists of a phosphate group, deoxyribose sugar, and a nitrogenous base.
DNA has four nitrogen bases: adenine, thymine, guanine, and cytosine.
Adenine pairs with thymine and guanine pairs with cytosine.
